about_the_game:
"Three Rivers Overlord" (Titanslord) is a 3DMMORPG large-scale online game with the background of Nordic mythology developed by Xi 'an Shichuang. Through the field map, copy the map to get experience upgrades, learn skills, get equipment and materials, use specific materials to synthesize can get elf equipment; A team can consist of up to 5 people with bonus experience; In the system, animals can be moved, and wings can be flown and moved;
The system currently has individual PK, team PK, line battle, free at any time; There will be regular siege battles, become the city master, enter the exclusive map.
